test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No computer is a marker.

All erasers are markers.

All pens are erasers.

**Conclusions:**

I. No pen is a computer.

II. Some erasers are computers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
**Given Statements:**

No computer is a marker.

All erasers are markers.

All pens are erasers.

**Venn Diagram Representation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc30bf196320d0ed8c78a1f5686f8233c589305e0f08e7c2b97415027daef6fa.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aec2594b9699e5024a6a0b7cd30e475d69e197b860668526e3c5007d7e298ed3.png] ​

**Conclusions:**

**No pen is a computer. → **True. (If no computer is a marker, and all pens are markers, then it logically follows that no pen can be a computer.)

**Some erasers are computers. **→ False. (If all erasers are markers and markers have no overlap with computers, then erasers can have no overlap with computers either. Therefore, some erasers being computers is not possible.)

Only Conclusion I follows from the given statements.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
